title: Each type at Sunday breakfast
caption:
Sunday breakfast reveals everyone's true personality.

One placed the halwa puri order last night. One started a debate on whether nihari counts as breakfast. One turned it into a gathering for 22 people. And one woke up at 1 pm asking what breakfast is.

Tag the person who always goes to fetch the nashta.

What's your Sunday breakfast order?
